Enapter
Enapter is the company that developed and patented the EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser for on-site hydrogen production.

El 4.0
El 4.0 is Enapter's patented anion exchange membrane electrolyser, described as a standardised, stackable, and flexible system designed to produce on-site hydrogen, with a modular design and advanced software integration enabling setup in minutes and remote control.

Anion Exchange Membrane
Anion Exchange Membrane is a membrane technology utilized in the EL 4.0 electrolyser for hydrogen production.

Hydrogen
Hydrogen is the chemical substance produced on-site by the EL 4.0 electrolyser, with flowrate adjustable through stacking.

Modular Design
Modular Design is the design philosophy of the EL 4.0 that allows the electrolyser to be stacked to achieve the required hydrogen flowrate.

Www.Enapter.Com/Aem-Electrolyser
Www.Enapter.Com/Aem-Electrolyser is the product web page URL for the AEM Electrolyser EL 4.0, providing information about Enapter's anion exchange membrane electrolyser.

Advanced Software Integration
Advanced Software Integration is a system feature of the EL 4.0 that enables setup in minutes and remote control and management of the electrolyser.
